justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/com/google/googlejavaformat/java/Main.java (283 LOC, 8 methods, 4 public entrypoints). The class is mostly a CLI orchestrator: argument parsing/validation is delegated to CommandLineOptionsParser.java, per-file formatting is delegated to FormatFileCallable.java, and Tool integration is handled by GoogleJavaFormatTool.java. Main’s methods cluster around one workflow (main/format/formatFiles/formatStdin/processArgs), so there is not strong evidence of insufficient modularization.
